exposure: Single dose of methotrexate (50 mg administered locally intracavitary + 50 mg administered intramuscularly) and folinic acid (15 mg/day orally for 30 days)
finding: This study suggests that methotrexate and folinic acid may be a promising treatment option for cesarean scar pregnancy in the first 10 weeks, while expectant management can be considered for clinically stable women with a non-viable embryo.
